issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a method named `createPerson` in PersonResource, but the solution implements the POST handler as `addPerson`. This mismatch between the documented method name (`createPerson`) and the actual implementation (`addPerson`) can confuse students when mapping the task description to the server code and when comparing with the NoteResource naming (`createNote`).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either rename the solution method to `createPerson` (to match the problem statement and NoteResource naming), or update the problem statement (and any test descriptions) to use `addPerson`. Ensure examples and instructions consistently use the chosen name.
